note: Invented sentences any vendor's agent may write, held to every vendor's table (sprint_3 3.0). No value comes from a real page. Written after the tables and measured unseen first: 10 of 20 right for every vendor, every miss a missed or vague claim, none a wrong action (Decisions [3.0]). The tables then learned plural event words, reminders, live listings and other actions; three phrasings stay missed on purpose (a new start time, a renewal that will change, a move of something not named as an event), since reading them would also read things that are no calendar or plan change.
